en: Split-image color postcard. The top photo shows children and adults on a sandy beach by the Black Sea, with kids building a sandcastle. A white band across the middle reads "ROMÂNIA • MANGALIA • ROMÂNIA." The bottom photo shows a landscaped resort area with modernist buildings (including the Cazino restaurant), a red 1970s car on a road, and flowerbeds. The reverse has Romanian handwriting, a blue 40 bani 'POSTA ROMANA' stamp, and Bucharest postmarks dated 1973.
